name: Naturewatch
body:
School necromancy; Level bloodlord 0, druid 0, ranger 1, shaman 0, witch 0

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range 30 ft.

Area cone-shaped emanation

Duration 10 min./level

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

This spell functions as deathwatch, except it only detects animals and plants. In addition to the normal information provided by the spell, it allows you to also know the other mundane status information like nourishment or hydration levels, if applicable.
